_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.50.0; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.68.0 for own queries in an agent's tab, copies of shared policies and the agent at the bottom of the sidebar. beamlynx-ui 0.68.0 still needs pine-lang 0.50 (its RequiredVersion).
